_about: Rooms with centred connectors for branching dungeons.
Three sizes, in tiles: small (1x1), medium (1x2) and large (2x2).
Small: D (dead end, one opening, north), I (straight), L (corner), T (east, south and west) and X (all four sides).
Medium: I, L (north + east on the bottom tile), J (mirror of L), S (east on the top tile, west on the bottom) and Z (mirror of S).
Large: L (north on the top-left tile, east on the bottom-right), S (north on the top-left, south on the bottom-right) and Z (mirror of S).
Each room is one shape; its 'images' are art variations, spread evenly over the rooms placed.
No 'copies', so each room can be used any number of times.
Weights match dungeon-generator's: X 4, T 5, I 2, L 1 (MD_I like I; the other mediums and larges 1). D is 0.25: fewer dead ends, so fewer that miss a marker slot.
no_connect keeps straights (SM_I, MD_I) from joining end to end into long corridors.
